I've had deep depression at times in my life, but somehow I have always had HOPE that it will all pass. And eventually it has.  But as much as I want to help all suicidal tendancy people (and I have a couple) it's very hard too. And it's harder for those of us that are left to cope with the loss too. So I feel your pain brother.  But just know you could not have helped.  🙌

I leave this comment as my manifestation, my silent prayer, and my hope for the future.

To Jehovah God, if You can hear the deepest prayers of my heart, please bless me and my wife with the greatest gift we have been waiting for, our own child. More than a decade of waiting, hoping, and praying has passed, and honestly, I am tired. I am exhausted, not because I have given up, but because I have been trying so hard to make our dream come true.

I left my home country and went abroad to work, sacrificing time, comfort, and precious moments of my life just to earn more and prepare for the future we dream of. I keep pushing myself financially because I want to give my wife the chance to become a mother and to finally hold our own little miracle in our arms. We are even trying to save enough for the medical procedures that might help us have a child.

I am turning 37 soon, and sometimes the passing of time scares me. It feels like the clock never stops ticking, and while I keep fighting to build a better life, the dream closest to my heart still feels so far away. There are days when I wonder how much longer I need to be strong, how much longer we need to wait, and whether all these sacrifices will finally lead us to the happiness we have been praying for.

But deep inside, I still hope. I still believe that one day, our tears will turn into tears of joy, our waiting will have meaning, and our home will be filled with the laughter of a child we can call our own.

May our financial struggles finally come to an end. May every sacrifice be worth it. May God give us strength when we feel weak, peace when we feel anxious, and hope when our hearts are tired.

My greatest manifestation is simple: may my wife and I finally become parents, may we be blessed with a healthy child, and may the years of waiting finally turn into the most beautiful chapter of our lives.

If anyone comes across this comment, please include us in your prayers. We have been waiting for more than a decade, and we are still holding on to hope.

Jehovah God, I am tired, but I am still praying. Please let our miracle come soon.
